name: Miyao Mimi
source:
Hobbies: Shopping
Likes: The color pink
Dislikes: Indecisive people

Mimi is an ex-delinquent who somehow calmed down and changed her ways after entering high school. She is quiet and well-mannered, however her way of talking still remains the same.
